data.one_liner: Allows you to create a collapsible list of float buttons with animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to display a collapsible and expandable list of floating action buttons with built-in animations. It allows you to group multiple floating buttons under a single primary animated icon button.
use_when: You need to display multiple floating action buttons on a screen without cluttering the UI.
You want an animated menu triggered from a floating action button.
avoid_when: You require complex custom transitions beyond the built-in animated icon setup.
You are not using Material design floating action buttons.
strengths: Easy to set up and use with existing FloatingActionButtons.
Includes open/close icon animations out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires providing a unique heroTag parameter to every new FAB to avoid exceptions.
Limited documentation and very early version (0.0.2).
